section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a study on body image and mental health in the Portuguese population. Participants were recruited from three distinct institutions (one private company, one retail service, and one higher education institution) to achieve a heterogeneous sample across socioeconomic status, sex, and education level. Self-report questionnaires were administered in person by researchers, and the final sample was restricted to participants aged 35 years or younger with less than 15% missing data.
